dependency_review.method: Fetched and statically reviewed minimum direct runtime versions, their recursively resolved runtime dependencies, and the currently resolved direct versions. No sample code or installation scripts were executed. Compiler development commands and git prepare/build scripts were distinguished from registry install hooks.
dependency_review.limitation: No lockfile pins the external dependency graph; findings concern the reviewed artifacts and fetched versions, not future satisfying releases.

archive_review.notes: The 222 reports include the archive, 219 analyzed members and two dependency registry records. Six non-emitted members were manually read: a local re-export alias, collection manifest, and four declaration files. All were nonmalicious. Both minified p-Bz80byMy.js copies and CJS/ESM sanitizer chunks were traced; cleave facts were captured for these members. Base64 decode data becomes a Uint16Array HTML entity tree; source-map Base64 and LANG/file helpers belong to ordinary parser/PostCSS code.

rule_corrections.correction: Recognize the DOM tag-text helper. Exclude that helper from generic HTTP detection only without separately evidenced network fetches; protect literal/encoded URLs, response readers, POSTs and top-level beacons.
rule_corrections.retention: Plain network fetch, variable URL, bundled helper plus real network call, and beacon controls pass in both analyzers.

rule_corrections.correction: Move the exact name observations to source-name metadata; require OAuth protocol/token markers for the OAuth callback composite. Preserve original atom scopes.
Require word boundaries for POST/upload after Base64 encoding. Actual Base64 POST remains detected.

rule_corrections.claim: An identifier ending in $ is the jQuery $ alias
rule_corrections.correction: Require a standalone dollar alias boundary. Existing jQuery controls retain their matches.

rule_corrections.claim: Quoted alert/fetch syntax is an active JavaScript API call
rule_corrections.correction: Use parsed JS calls for live call observations; retain the original HTML syntax matchers as source metadata. Preserve consumers and HTML controls.

rule_corrections.claim: An HTML event attribute creates DOM or sends a request
rule_corrections.correction: Relocate both exact event-attribute matchers to source key/value metadata and update every explicit consumer. Parent-selector audit found no affected directory references.

rule_corrections.claim: A literal starting fetch( is a network operation
rule_corrections.correction: Move the exact literal matcher to source-literal metadata; retain its constructed-payload consumer and hostile positive control.

rule_corrections.correction: Name the composite for shared Indonesian/Malay function-word tokens; preserve every matched token and severity.

verification.classifier_disagreement: None on the three requested samples. External package reputation disagrees because the advisory concerns older releases; locale labels lack supporting artifact behavior.
verification.fixture_calibration: Reused the existing module-execution-http-call atom rather than a duplicate source observation. The visible installer-download control permits one additional source-metadata score point and requires that accurate observation; its zero hostile/suspicious caps are unchanged.

material_losses: Incorrect HTTP/OAuth/jQuery/POST/alert claims were removed or replaced by accurate source/DOM observations. The comparison contains no lost suspicious or hostile detection in the regression corpus; existing network, encoding, filesystem and rendering capabilities remain covered.
